proxy.comment: Your local proxy (FastLink / Clash / v2rayN etc.)

markers.comment: Marker files live under %USERPROFILE% and toggle proxy per tool

opencode.comment: Desktop = Electron GUI; cli = command run in terminal

antigravity.comment: Antigravity desktop is Electron; its language_server subprocess honors HTTPS_PROXY

cursor.comment: Cursor is Electron; its Node/extension-host traffic honors HTTPS_PROXY. CLI wrapper is not on PATH by default
